# A missing APPEND UID preserves the offline copy's unknown-key branch

This zero-UID landing makes OnCopyCompleted call the key mapper only for a nonzero APPEND UID. Zero leaves nsMsgKey_None for CopyFileToOfflineStore: the checked receiver skips adding a header when no offline copy is needed, or allocates a fake offline key when it is needed. The same landing separately defaults loaded UIDVALIDITY to zero and converts the legacy 0xffffffff member value. These bounded branches do not prove a general database migration, protocol compliance or a successful append/copy. No runtime scenario was executed.

Scope: IMAP copy completion and null UID.
